kind: no frontend of its own (CLI + slash commands inside Claude Code; docs-site is the stock VitePress theme): this design system was created for the repo
why: Everything ClaudeAutoPM shows a user is terminal text: the installer's double-line box, chalk-coloured status lines, and the output of /pm: commands in Claude Code. The design is that output, tidied: the double-line box carries the name, single-line boxes are diagram nodes, box-drawing branches and arrows are the edges.

derived_from.double_box: install/install.js ('ClaudeAutoPM Installation Script' box), bin/autopm.js (Quick Reference box), install/post-install-check.js
derived_from.palette: chalk colours used across bin/, install/ and lib/: cyan, green, yellow, red, gray, bold
derived_from.commands: packages/plugin-pm/commands and autopm/.claude/commands (pm:prd-new, pm:prd-parse, pm:epic-decompose, pm:epic-sync, pm:issue-start, pm:issue-close, pm:epic-status, pm:next)
derived_from.scenarios_and_counts: README.md Quick Install table; 14 packages/plugin-* directories

motif.name_box: 7px double border in cyan, the name in bold white, one gray line under it
motif.node: 1.5px single-line box on the pane colour; title is a command with its prompt ('> ' cyan inside Claude Code, '$ ' green in the shell)
motif.tree: box-drawing branches in gray, task numbers in cyan, agent names in gray
motif.status: green check, red cross, yellow dot, block-character progress bar

data: The project (checkout-redesign), its five tasks, the issue and pull request numbers and the coverage figure are invented.

assets.docs/images/how-it-works.png: src/diagram.html, 1600x900 @2x (opaque terminal frame: reads on GitHub dark and light)
